hypothesis: W-R49 established 11.94-point order sensitivity from identical examples with online perceptron. Compare an order-invariant full-batch update against both original and reverse online passes, under same 1728 development examples, feature width, 32 epochs and 16 weight parameters. Full batch may stabilize training under ordering but is not assumed to improve source-family generalization.
freeze: Prospectively freeze development seeds3040..3055, sealed heldout3056..3103 (48), original W-R49 affine_prior paired signed 1728 development examples, 3 heldout generator families, 2 swap sites, genuine-first/genuine-second order-balanced scoring, 4-bit identity and XOR55 conditions. Three arms: original_order online, reverse_order online, and full_batch 32 epochs accumulating signed misclassification gradient over all examples against the SAME frozen pre-epoch weights (batch update 0.1/N times sum, ties treated misclassified). Full batch gradient exact and independent of example iteration order. Numerical training compute differs, record update counts, gradient statistics, model fingerprints. Zero adaptive step size or post-outcome thresholds.
classification: BATCH_STABLE_USEFUL iff batch heldout order-balanced accuracy>=0.55 and exceeds BOTH online arms' average by >=0.05, and 2/3 family accuracies >0.52; PARTIAL_BATCH_GAIN iff batch exceeds online arms' average by >=0.02; NO_GAIN otherwise. Report exact arm accuracy, clusters, ties and all negative families, never promote the best after observing outcomes.
controls: Same 1728 development signed examples and 32 epochs for all, 16 zero-initialized weights, no intercept, 0.1 learning rate; online and full batch update semantics/hardware compute explicitly differ
No heldout training, threshold selection, learned family ID or privileged labels at inference. Both orientations balanced; exact XOR55 invariance required.
One original immutable first-use artifact and complete Go regression/build, no PR merge/accepted refs/controller or production mutation.
claim_limit: Synthetic two-alternative paired ranking and optimization sensitivity, not autonomous recurrent cognition or generalized language capability.
